name: Painted Surfaces of the World
subtitle: Hex signs, Tap-taps & more
shortDescription: Paint hex signs, lacquer trays, house fronts, bus panels and window screens: 6 traditions from 5 countries, offline.
longDescription:
Painted Surfaces of the World: 6 painted barn, tray, house, bus and window traditions from 5 countries, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Hex sign, Zhostovo tray, Cicmany house front, Tap-tap bus panel, Window screen painting and Zalipie flowers.

Each one has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can paint hex signs, lacquer trays, house fronts, bus panels and window screens in traditional styles, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
